title: From the available data from the 23 States/UTs, it is seen that the total occupancy exceeded the available total jail capacity in the UT of Dadra & Nagar Haveli and Delhi and in the States of Sikkim, Bihar, Jammu & Kashmir, Maharashtra, Meghalaya, Orissa, Uttar Pradesh and Goa. The highest occupancy of inmates during 1995 was recorded in Dadra & Nagar Haveli (326%). This was followed by UT of Delhi (269%) and the States of Sikkim (163%), Bihar (144%), Jammu & Kashmir (137%), Maharashtra (135%),
